title: Organization Compliance Modes: Selective Export Blocking & Scoped IP Filters (RBAC v2 Integration)
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Implement an org-level 'Compliance Mode' framework that lets admins apply coarse-grained policies (IP allowlist, disable public sharing, selective export blocking) while evaluating RBAC v2 predicates and emitting rich audit trails. This ticket covers API + Console toggles, enforcement hooks for data-export endpoints (CSV/JSON/Drive), and language model output sharing (public link generation), plus integration points for SSO/SAML group sync to map compliance exemptions.

Scope:
- Console: new Compliance Modes panel under Org Settings with three toggles and per-toggle rationale/help text.
- API: new org.control.* RPCs and HTTP admin endpoints for reading/updating compliance mode flags.
- Enforcement: middleware that consults RBAC v2 policy store to allow scoped exceptions (e.g., service accounts with export permission), and checks IP allowlist per-request.
- Audit: generate structured audit events for every state change and for every blocked export/share attempt; events must include org_id, actor_id, resource_type, resource_id, rule_id, decision (allow/deny), and policy_snapshot_version.
- Migration & Rollout: default mode = OFF; provide an opt-in beta for security customers and opt-in via 'Compliance Trial' flag.

Success criteria: admin can flip toggles in Console and the behavior is enforced for org resources and documented in audit logs; RBAC exceptions honored; no regression in existing sharing/export APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows a Compliance Modes panel with three toggles and contextual tooltips
Admin API can read/update compliance flags and returns policy_snapshot_version
Export endpoints (CSV/JSON/Drive) check Compliance Mode and return 403 with structured audit event when blocked
Public-sharing endpoints refuse to create public links when 'disable public sharing' is enabled and record why
IP allowlist enforcement blocks non-allowed requests for admin endpoints and exports; exceptions allowed via RBAC v2 policies
Every toggle state change produces an audit event stored in audit-log stream with required fields
E2E tests cover policy exceptions, blocked export telemetry, and SSO group exemption scenarios
implementation_notes: Create a small state-machine for Compliance Mode to support future flags beyond the initial three
Introduce org_control_config table with versioned rows and 'policy_snapshot_version' for correlating audit events
Enforcement middleware should be pluggable - used by both Console and API gateways and also by the serving runtime for model-level sharing endpoints
RBAC v2 predicates will be evaluated using the existing policy-eval service; add a short-circuit for 'org_admin_override' only with explicit allow
SSO/SAML group sync will map external group names to RBAC roles; product will provide default mappings in Confluence doc linked below
audit_log_requirements: Fields required: timestamp, org_id, actor_id, actor_type (user/service), resource_type, resource_id, action, decision, rule_id, policy_snapshot_version, request_ip, request_headers_masked
Blocked export events should include original_export_payload_hash (non-reversible) to help post-mortem without leaking data
Toggle-change events must include previous_state and new_state plus actor_reason (optional)
